module: Player "recovery" menu (tow to the road, flip upright, repair, return to garage, quick travel, reset the vehicle, restart or submit a mission, give back a delivery or loaned vehicle). It keeps a table of buttons (buttonOptions) with target type (vehicle, walk, none), inclusion and activation conditions, price and function run during a screen fade. The buttons are exposed in the radial menu (core_quickAccess) and in the pause menu rails. A modder adds their own buttons with addButton and controls which ones are active.
usage:
core_recoveryPrompt.addButton('myTeleport', 'My teleport', function(target) --[[ ... ]] end, 30, nil, true, true, true, 'car')
core_recoveryPrompt.setButtonActiveById('myTeleport', false)
notes: Built-in buttons: towToRoad, flipUpright, getFavoriteVehicle, flipMission, recoverMission, submitMission, restartMission, repairHere, resetVehicle, stopTestdrive, giveBackDeliveryVehicle, returnLoanedVehicle; plus, in career, towTo<garage> and quickTravelTo<garage> and quickTravelToVehicle (added by setDefaultsForCareer).
Only buttons added with addButton (customButton) can be removed by removeButtonById or overwritten by a new addButton.

Flow: buttonPressed stores the button and its target; if fadeActive, plays the sound, starts ui_fadeScreen.start(0.3); onScreenFadeState then calls handleCurrRecoveryOption, which emits the hook onRecoveryPromptButtonPressed(id), runs atFadeFunction(target), increments the counter, displays the message, stops the fade. In career outside the market and outside a mission, a 'beforeTeleport' part state snapshot is created beforehand.
Thresholds: vehicleSlow = speed < 10 m/s; vehicleStopped = speed < 0.5 m/s.
Career prices: 50 for flipUpright, 75 for towToRoad, free if roadside assistance is free for the vehicle.
Probable BUG: in getButtonsForTarget, the loop over includeConditions overwrites 'add' on each condition, so only the last condition counts.
Probable BUG: addButton, on an order collision, reads o.id which does not exist on the entries (the log message contains nil); and its first log('E', ...) passes the message in place of the tag.

Probable BUG: setButtonLimits crashes if a key of limits is not an existing button identifier (buttonOptions[id] is nil). createPopupData uses the undefined variable 'title' (is nil, so the title is always the default translation).
This module calls career_career, gameplay_walk, gameplay_missions_missionManager, etc. without protection; it assumes these extensions are loaded.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the recovery menu is globally active.

setActive.desc: Enables or disables the recovery menu globally.

setDefaultsForFreeroam.desc: Freeroam setting: disables the menu and all buttons.

setDefaultsForCareer.desc: Career setting: enables the menu, keeps only towToRoad, flipUpright, getFavoriteVehicle, stopTestdrive, giveBackDeliveryVehicle, returnLoanedVehicle active, and adds the tow and quick travel buttons to the level's garages.

setDefaultsForTutorial.desc: Tutorial setting: enables the menu with only towToRoad, repairHere and flipUpright.

setEverythingActive.desc: Enables the menu and all buttons.

deactivateAllButtons.desc: Disables all buttons (the menu stays in its state).

setButtonActiveById.desc: Enables or disables a button. Logs a warning if the id is unknown.

getButtonActiveById.desc: Indicates whether a button is active.

returns.desc: nil if the id is unknown.

setButtonEnabledById.desc: Changes the enabled state of a button; if e is true, the button also becomes active.

addButton.desc: Adds a custom button (implicit type 'none' since there is no type field: it only appears in the list of 'none' targets). Refuses to overwrite a built-in button.

atFadeFunction.desc: Function run during the fade; receives the target {type, vehId}.

order.desc: Display order; default = largest existing order + 1.

message.desc: Translation key of the message displayed after the action.

fadeActive.desc: Play a screen fade, true by default.

removeButtonById.desc: Removes a custom button. Refused for built-in buttons.

setButtonLimits.desc: Sets the maximum number of uses per button (resets all limits first; -1 = unlimited). When a limit exists, the label shows the remaining uses.

resetButtonLimitCounters.desc: Resets the buttons' use counter to 0.

onlyFor.desc: Set of ids concerned; nil = all.

getButtonLimitsAndCounts.desc: Returns each button's limit and counter.

serializeState.desc: Serializes the state (global active and each button's active state) for saving.

deserializeState.desc: Restores the state produced by serializeState.

buttonPressed.desc: Runs the recovery process for a button: optional part snapshot, then screen fade (start sound then ui_fadeScreen.start) before the action, or immediate action if fadeActive is false.

target.desc: Target: type 'vehicle', 'walk' or 'none', and vehId for a vehicle.

handleCurrRecoveryOption.desc: Runs the current recovery option (called at the end of the fade): hook onRecoveryPromptButtonPressed, atFadeFunction, counter, message, end of fade and UI router reload.

onPopupClosed.desc: Popup close hook: forgets the current option and the popup data.

onScreenFadeState.desc: ui_fadeScreen hook: on each state change, calls handleCurrRecoveryOption (which does nothing if there is no pending request).

getPauseMissionRightRailButtons.desc: Buttons to display in the right rail of the pause menu in a mission: restartMission, flipMission, recoverMission, towToRoad (player vehicle and none targets). Each entry: id, title, icon, holdToClick, enabled, disableReason, order, startSlot, targetType, targetVehId.

getPauseCareerRightRailButtons.desc: Buttons of the right rail of the pause menu in career: flipUpright and towToRoad for the player's vehicle.

getCustomRecoveryOptionsActiveState.desc: Returns a cleaned list of recovery options (active or not): active, enabled, label (translated if text), icon, isRecoveryOption.

onResetGameplay.desc: Hook called when gameplay is reset: if the menu is active and no recovery is in progress, opens the quick menu (core_quickAccess) on the career, mission or quick root depending on the context.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: builds the button table (setupButtonOptions).

onBeforeRadialOpened.desc: Hook called before the radial menu opens: the first time, registers the recovery entries in core_quickAccess (root, quickTravel/, towing/).

onHideRadialMenu.desc: Hook: the radial menu is closed, the popup data is cleared.

onQuickAccessLoaded.desc: Hook: core_quickAccess was reloaded, the entries will need to be re-registered the next time it opens.
